content.short: Ada Moments lets collectors own Cardano time stamps and add content to shared on-chain moments over time.
content.description: Ada Moments is a Cardano NFT project built around Ada Time Stamps, or ATS, which represent defined moments in the Cardano blockchain timeline. Collectors can own these moments and add content through Ada's Museum, creating a layered record of history, memory, and community expression. The project turns time itself into a collectible canvas, starting from Cardano's genesis block and extending forward as users contribute new pieces of content to individual ATS NFTs and historical moments over time.
content.meta: Ada Moments turns Cardano blockchain time stamps into collectible NFTs and shared history. Explore Ada Moments on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
